spans.s: प्रकट a. (f. टा) 1. Clear, evident, apparent, manifest; 2. undisguised, public; 3. visible.(प्रकटम् is also used as an indeclinable in the above senses.)
प्रकट a. (f. टा) 1. Clear, evident, apparent, manifest; 2. undisguised, public; 3. visible.(प्रकटम् is also used as an indeclinable in the above senses.)
प्रकट-प्रीतिवर्धन m. an epithet of Śiva.
प्रकटन n. The act of manifesting or disclosing.
प्रकटित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested, unfolded; 2. publicly exhibited.
प्रकटित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested, unfolded; 2. publicly exhibited.
प्रकंप m. Trembling, shaking, violent motion, बाला चाहं मनसिजभयात्प्राप्तगाढप्रकंपा Sr.
प्रकंपन (I) m. 1. Wind, air (generally violent), प्रकंपनेनानुचलंपिरे सुराः Sis.i.61; 2. name of a hell.
प्रकंपन (II) n. Violent trembling, excessive motion.
प्रकर (I) m. 1. A heap, a multitude, a quantity, पुनर्दृष्टिं बाष्पप्रकरकलुषामर्पितवती Sak.vi., R.ix.56, K.S.v.68; 2. a nosegay; 3. aid, assistance; 4. practice, usage; 5. seduction, abduction.
प्रकर (II) n. Aloe-wood.
प्रकार m. 1. Sort, kind, variety, मणिप्रकाराः सरसं च चंदनम् Rt.i.2, Yaj.iii.216; 2. manner, mode, fashion; 3. similitude; 4. property, quality, speciality.
प्राकार m. A wall, a rampart, R.xii.71, M.vii.74.

प्रकरण n. 1. Opportunity, occasion; 2. subject, topic; 3. a section or chapter of a book; 4. an introduction, a prologue; 5. a species of dramatic composition (thus described by S.D.- भवेत्प्रकरणे वृत्तं लौकिकं कविकल्पितम् । शृंगारोऽंगी नायकोऽस्ति विप्रोऽमात्योऽथवा वणिक् । सापायधर्मकामार्थपरो धीरप्रशांतकः), e.g. मृच्छकटिक, मालतीमाधव.
प्रकरणिका f. A minor drama of the same character as the प्रकरण, (thus described by the S.D.- नाटिकैव प्रकरणिका सार्थवाहादिनायिका । समानवंशजा नेतुर्भवेद्यत्र च नायिका).
प्राकरणिक a. (f. की) Belonging to the subject under discussion, relevant to the matter in hand; (the word is sometimes used in the sense of Upameya in rhetorical works).
प्रकरणिका f. A minor drama of the same character as the प्रकरण, (thus described by the S.D.- नाटिकैव प्रकरणिका सार्थवाहादिनायिका । समानवंशजा नेतुर्भवेद्यत्र च नायिका).
प्रकरिका f. An interlude inserted in a drama to explain what is to follow.
प्रकरी f. 1. An interlude inserted in a drama to explain what is to follow; 2. theatrical dress; 3. an open piece of ground; 4. a place where four roads meet.

प्रकर्ष m. 1. Intensity, eminence, excellence, वपुः प्रकर्षादजयद्गुरुं रघुः R.iii.34, वर्णप्रकर्षे सति K.S.iii.28; 2. strength, power; 3. length, protractedness.(The inst. and abl. singulars, viz., प्रकर्षेण and प्रकर्षात् are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘eminently, exceedingly, in a high degree.’)
प्रकर्षण n. 1. The act of dragging away; 2. the act of ploughing; 3. excellence, superiority; 4. duration, length.
प्रकला f. A minute portion.
प्राच्-काल m. a former age.
प्रकल्पना f. Settlement, allotment, M.viii.211.
प्रकल्पित a. (f. ता) 1. Made; 2. settled, allotted.
प्रकल्पित a. (f. ता) 1. Made; 2. settled, allotted.
प्रकल्पिता f. A kind of riddle.

प्रकांड (I) m.n. 1. The trunk of a tree from the root to the branches; 2. (at the end of a compound) anything excellent of its kind, दंतप्रकांडेषु सितेषु शुभ्रतां कुंभेषु दानांबुघनेषु पंकताम् K.S.xv.10.
प्रकांड (II) m. A branch, a shoot.
प्रकांडक m. The same as प्रकांड q.v., Bt.v.6.
प्रकांडर m. A tree.
प्रकाम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Much, excessive, to the heart’s content, R.ii.11, K.S.ii.24; 2. amorous.
प्रकाम (II) m. Desire, pleasure.(प्रकामम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) exceedingly, R.vi.44; (2) to the heart’s content; (3) willingly, voluntarily.)
प्रकाम (I) a. (f. मा) 1. Much, excessive, to the heart’s content, R.ii.11, K.S.ii.24; 2. amorous.
प्रकाम-भुज् a. eating till satisfied, R.i.66.

प्रकाश (I) a. (f. शा) 1. Visible, manifest, Bg.vii.25; 2. bright, shining, प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोक इवाचलः R.i.68, v.2; 3. open, public; 4. famous, renowned, R.iii.48; 5. expanded, open; 6. open, denuded of trees, R.iv.31; 7. (at the end of a compound) looking like.

प्रकाश (II) m. 1. Lustre, light, splendour, brightness; 2. sunshine; 3. fame, renown, celebrity; 4. manifestation, display; 5. an open spot; 6. a golden mirror; 7. a chapter or section of a book; 8. (at the end of titles of works) elucidation, e.g. काव्यप्रकाश, भावप्रकाश &c.

प्रकाश (III) n. Brass.[प्रकाशम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) openly, publicly, स हंतव्यः प्रकाशं विविधैर्वधैः M.viii.193; (2) aloud, audibly (used as a stage-direction in this sense).]

प्रकाश (I) a. (f. शा) 1. Visible, manifest, Bg.vii.25; 2. bright, shining, प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोक इवाचलः R.i.68, v.2; 3. open, public; 4. famous, renowned, R.iii.48; 5. expanded, open; 6. open, denuded of trees, R.iv.31; 7. (at the end of a compound) looking like.
प्रकाश-आत्मक a. shining, brilliant.
प्रकाश-आत्मन् m. 1. the sun; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
प्रकाश-इतर a. invisible.
प्रकाश-क्रय m. an open purchase.
प्रकाश-नारी f. A public woman, a prostitute, a harlot, प्रकाशनारीधृत एष यस्मात् Mrich.iii.
प्रकाशक (I) a. (f. शिका) 1. Making apparent, discovering, disclosing; 2. explaining; 3. luminous, giving light; 4. brilliant, shining; 5. noted, renowned.
प्रकाशक (II) m. 1. The sun; 2. a discoverer.
प्रकाशक (I) a. (f. शिका) 1. Making apparent, discovering, disclosing; 2. explaining; 3. luminous, giving light; 4. brilliant, shining; 5. noted, renowned.
प्राकषिक m. 1. A man supported by another’s wife; 2. a catamite.
प्रकाशक-ज्ञातृ m. 1. the sun; 2. a cock.
प्रकाशन (I) n. 1. Illuminating, making bright; 2. making manifest, making known; 3. displaying.
प्रकाशन (II) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रकाशित a. (f. ता) 1. Made evident, manifested; 2. illuminated, enlightened; 3. published.
प्रकाशित a. (f. ता) 1. Made evident, manifested; 2. illuminated, enlightened; 3. published.
प्रकिरण n. Scattering, strewing.

प्रकीर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Scattered about, dispersed, scattered forth, प्रकीर्णः पुष्पाणां हरिचरणयोरंजलिरयम् Ve.i.; 2. published, spread; 3. disordered, confused; 4. agitated, excited; 5. miscellaneous, e.g. the प्रकीर्णकांड of the Bhaṭṭikāvya.
प्रकीर्ण (II) n. 1. Miscellany, miscellanea; 2. a chapter containing miscellaneous rules.

प्रकीर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Scattered about, dispersed, scattered forth, प्रकीर्णः पुष्पाणां हरिचरणयोरंजलिरयम् Ve.i.; 2. published, spread; 3. disordered, confused; 4. agitated, excited; 5. miscellaneous, e.g. the प्रकीर्णकांड of the Bhaṭṭikāvya.
प्रकीर्णक (I) a. (f. का) Scattered about.
प्रकीर्णक (II) m.n. A chowrie, a fly-flap.
प्रकीर्णक (III) m. A horse.
प्रकीर्णक (IV) n. 1. A miscellany, any collection of miscellaneous things; 2. a miscellaneous chapter.
प्रकीर्णक (I) a. (f. का) Scattered about.
प्रकीर्तित n. 1. Proclaiming, announcing; 2. praising, extolling.
प्रकीर्ति f. 1. Declaration; 2. praise; 3. fame, celebrity.
प्रकुंच m. A particular measure of capacity.
प्रकुपित a. (f. ता) 1. Very angry, enraged; 2. stimulated.
प्रकुपित a. (f. ता) 1. Very angry, enraged; 2. stimulated.
प्रकुल n. A handsome body.
प्राच्-कूल a. having the points turned towards the east, M.ii.75.
प्रकूष्मांडी f. An epithet of Durgā.

प्रकृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Commenced, begun; 2. that which is under consideration, the subject in hand; (in this sense often used for the upameya in works on rhetoric, e.g. प्रकृतं यन्निषिध्यान्यत् साध्यते सा त्वपह्नुतिः K.Pr.x.); 3. genuine, real; 4. appointed, charged; 5. important, interesting.
प्रकृत (II) n. the original subject, e.g. किमनया परदोषगवेषणया प्रकृतमनुसरामः.

प्रकृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Commenced, begun; 2. that which is under consideration, the subject in hand; (in this sense often used for the upameya in works on rhetoric, e.g. प्रकृतं यन्निषिध्यान्यत् साध्यते सा त्वपह्नुतिः K.Pr.x.); 3. genuine, real; 4. appointed, charged; 5. important, interesting.

प्राकृत (I) a. (f. ता or ती) 1. Original, natural, unmodified; (in this sense the word is applied to the sovereign of an adjacent country, who, in politics, is considered a natural enemy; See Sis.ii.36 (and Mall. on it); 2. common, ordinary, uncultivated, vulgar, Bg.xviii.24; 3. derived from प्रकृति (q.v.) (in Sāṅkhya phil.).
प्राकृत (II) m. A low man, an ordinary man.

प्राकृत (III) n. A vernacular dialect, derived from Sanskrit; (many of these dialects are used in Sanskrit plays in speeches assigned to female characters and to low personages), भोः कार्यवशात्प्रयोगवशाच्चाहं प्राकृतभाषी संव्रुत्तः Mrich.i.

प्राकृत (I) a. (f. ता or ती) 1. Original, natural, unmodified; (in this sense the word is applied to the sovereign of an adjacent country, who, in politics, is considered a natural enemy; See Sis.ii.36 (and Mall. on it); 2. common, ordinary, uncultivated, vulgar, Bg.xviii.24; 3. derived from प्रकृति (q.v.) (in Sāṅkhya phil.).
प्राच्-कृत n. an act done in a previous life.
प्रकृत-अर्थ m. the original sense.

प्रकृति (I) f. 1. The original or natural form of anything, the natural state, (op. to विकृति ‘change’), मरणं प्रकृतिः शरीरिणां विकृतिर्जीवितमुच्यते बुधैः R.viii.87, महीयांसः प्रकृत्या मितभाषिणः Sis.ii.13, Bg.vii.4; (प्रकृतिं आपद् ‘to come to one’s senses’); 2. natural disposition, constitution, temperament; 3. origin, source, material cause, the matter out of which anything is formed, प्रकृतिश्च प्रतिज्ञादृष्टांतानुपरोधात् /Vedānta S./i.4; 4. a pattern, a model, a standard (in ritualistic works); 5. a mother; 6. a woman; 7. the male organ of generation; 8. the female organ of generation; 9. the source of the material world consisting of the three primary qualities of सत्व, रजस् and तमस्, as distinguished from Purusha (in Sāṅkhya phil.); 10. the personified will of the supreme spirit (in mythology), Bg.ix.10; 11. the crude form of a word to which case-terminations and other affixes are subjoined (in gram.).

प्रकृति (II) f. pl. 1. A king’s ministers, R.xii.12; 2. the subjects of a king; 3. the constituent elements of the states (they are- (1) the king; (2) the minister; (3) the allies; (4) the treasure; (5) territory; (6) fortresses; (7) army; according to some also (8) subjects); 4. the various kings to be considered in the event of war, See M.vii.155 and Kull. on it; 5. the eight primary elements out of which every thing is evolved (in Sāṅkhya phil.) See /Sāṅkhya K./3; 6. the five primary elements of creation (viz., पृथ्वी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु and आकाश).
प्रकृति-कृपण a. naturally disposed to lament, Megh.i.5.
प्रकृति-तरल a. naturally fickle, प्रकृतितरले का नः पीडा गते हतजीविते Am.
प्रकृति-पुरुष m. a minister of state, Megh.i.6.
प्रकृति-मंडल n. the entire kingdom, the whole empire, R.ix.2.
प्रकृति-सिद्ध n. natural, innate.
प्रकृति-सुभग a. naturally agreeable.
प्रकृति-स्थ a. 1. in the natural condition, genuine; 2. in good health; 3. stripped of everything; 4. innate, inherent; 5. come to oneself.
प्रकृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Drawn out, lengthy, long; 2. disquieted; 3. excellent, exalted, eminent.
प्रकृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Drawn out, lengthy, long; 2. disquieted; 3. excellent, exalted, eminent.
प्रकॢप्त a. (f. प्ता) Prepared, made ready.
प्रकॢप्त a. (f. प्ता) Prepared, made ready.
प्रकोथ m. Putrefaction, putridity.
प्रकोष्ठ m. 1. The forearm, the wrist, कनकवलयभ्रंशारिक्तप्रकोष्ठः Megh.i.2, K.S.iii.41; 2. a room near the gate of a palace; 3. a court in a house, a square surrounded by buildings, Mrich.v.
प्रकोष्ठक m. A room near the gate of a palace, तस्थुर्विनम्रक्षितिपालसंकुले तदंगनद्वारप्रकोष्ठके K.S.xv.6.
प्रक्खर m. 1. An armour for the defence of a horse; 2. a dog; 3. a mule.
प्रक्खर m. 1. An armour for the defence of a horse; 2. a dog; 3. a mule.
प्रक्रम m. 1. A step, a stride; 2. a pace considered as a measure of distance; 3. commencement, beginning; 4. proportion, order, method; 5. leisure, opportunity.

प्रक्रम-भंग m. want of regularity in expression considered as a fault of composition; (as an instance may be cited the stanza, गाहंतां महिषा निपानसलिलम् &c. (Sak.ii.) where there is an irregularity of expression in the third line which may be relieved by reading it as विश्रब्धा रचयंतु शूकरवरा मुस्ताक्षतिं पल्वले. See K.Pr.vii.)
प्रक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Commenced, begun; 2. under discussion, in hand; 3. valorous.
प्रक्रांत a. (f. ता) 1. Commenced, begun; 2. under discussion, in hand; 3. valorous.
प्रक्रिया f. 1. Way, manner, conduct; 2. the bearing of royal insignia; 3. high position; 4. a chapter or section of a book, e.g. उणादिप्रक्रिया; 5. etymological formation (in gram.).
प्रक्रीड m. Play, pastime.
प्रक्लिन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Moist, wet; 2. satisfied.
प्रक्लिन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Moist, wet; 2. satisfied.
प्रक्वण m. The sound of a lute.
प्रक्वण m. The sound of a lute.
प्रक्षय m. Ruin, destruction.
प्रक्षरण n. Trickling, oozing.
प्रक्षालन n. 1. Washing, washing off, R.vi.48; 2. cleaning, purifying; 3. bathing; 4. anything used for purifying; 5. water for washing.
प्रक्षालित a. (f. ता) 1. Washed; 2. cleaning, purifying.
प्रक्षालित a. (f. ता) 1. Washed; 2. cleaning, purifying.
प्रक्षिप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Thrown at, hurled; 2. interpolated, spurious.
प्रक्षिप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Thrown at, hurled; 2. interpolated, spurious.
प्रक्षीण a. (f. णा) 1. Decayed; 2. destroyed; 3. disappeared, vanished.
प्रक्षीण a. (f. णा) 1. Decayed; 2. destroyed; 3. disappeared, vanished.
प्रक्षुण्ण a. (f. ण्णा) 1. Crushed; 2. incited.
प्रक्षुण्ण a. (f. ण्णा) 1. Crushed; 2. incited.
प्रक्षेप m. 1. Projecting, casting forward; 2. a throw, a cast; 3. interpolation; 4. the sum deposited by every member of a commercial corporation.
प्रक्षेपण n. Throwing, casting.
प्रक्षोभण n. Exciting, agitating.
प्रक्ष्वेडन n. 1. An iron arrow; 2. clamour.
प्रक्ष्वेडित a. (f. ता) Clamorous, noisy.
प्रक्ष्वेडित a. (f. ता) Clamorous, noisy.

प्राक् ind. (generally with an abl.) 1. Already, before, प्रमन्यवः प्रागपि कोसलेंद्रे R.vii.34, प्राक् सृष्टेः केवलात्मने K.S.ii.4, R.xiv.78; 2. in front; 3. as far as, up to, e.g. प्राक् कडारात् ‘up to the word kadāru’ Pan.; 4. in the east; 5. previously, in the previous portion (of a book), M.i.79.
प्राकट्य n. Publicity, notoriety.
प्राकरणिक a. (f. की) Belonging to the subject under discussion, relevant to the matter in hand; (the word is sometimes used in the sense of Upameya in rhetorical works).
प्राकर्षिक a. (f. की) Deserving preference.
प्राकर्षिक a. (f. की) Deserving preference.
प्राकाम्य n. 1. Irresistible will considered as one of the eight superhuman powers of Śiva or the supreme being; (See under शक्ति and ईशिता); 2. freedom of will, प्राकाम्यं ते विभूतिषु K.S.ii.11.
प्राकार-स्थ a. stationed on a rampart, M.vii.74.
प्राकारीय a. (f. या) 1. Fit for a wall (as bricks); 2. surrounded by a wall.
प्राकारीय a. (f. या) 1. Fit for a wall (as bricks); 2. surrounded by a wall.
प्राकाश्य n. 1. Publicity; 2. fame, renown.
प्राकृत-अरि m. a natural enemy, i.e. the sovereign of an adjacent country.
प्राकृत-उदासीन m. a natural neutral, i.e. a king whose dominions lie beyond those of the natural ally.
प्राकृत-ज्वर m. a common fever.
प्राकृत-प्रलय m. total destruction of the world.
प्राकृत-मित्र n. natural ally, e.g. a sovereign whose kingdom lies next to that of the natural enemy.
प्राकृतिक a. (f. का) 1. Natural; 2. illusory.
प्राकृतिक a. (f. का) 1. Natural; 2. illusory.
प्राच्-कर्मन् n. an action done in a previous life.
प्राच्-कालीन a. belonging to ancient times, ancient.
प्राच्-चरणा f. the female organ of generation.
प्राच्-चिरम् ind. before it is too late.
प्राच्-तन a. (f. नी) 1. ancient, old; 2. former, previous, antecedent, प्रपेदिरे प्राक्तनजन्मविद्याः K.S.i.30; 3. relating to a previous birth, संस्काराः प्राक्तना इव R.i.20, K.S.vi.10.
प्राच्-तन a. (f. नी) 1. ancient, old; 2. former, previous, antecedent, प्रपेदिरे प्राक्तनजन्मविद्याः K.S.i.30; 3. relating to a previous birth, संस्काराः प्राक्तना इव R.i.20, K.S.vi.10.
प्राच्-प्रहार m. first blow, प्रहर नमय चापं प्राक्प्रहारप्रियोऽहम् Mv.ii.
प्राच्-फल m. the bread-fruit-tree.
प्राच्-फल्गुनी, -फाल्गुनी f. the eleventh lunar mansion.
प्राच्-फल्गुनी, -फाल्गुनी f. the eleventh lunar mansion.
प्राच्-फल्गुनी˚भव m. 1. an epithet of Bṛhaspati; 2. the planet Jupiter.
प्राच्-फाल्गुन, -फाल्गुनेय m. the planet Jupiter.
प्राच्-फाल्गुन, -फाल्गुनेय m. the planet Jupiter.
